description: Get the signed-in person's own Typeza personality type: name, subtitle, quadra and its typeza.ai page. Call it when the person asks what their type is, or before explaining how they relate to someone. Needs their Typeza account connected with the profile permission. Returns status type_found with the type, or status no_type_yet when they have not found their type yet: then offer the test here with start_test, which saves the result to their account, or give them test_url. Outputs use the Typeza type name, never a code.
name: get_my_type
title: Get my personality type
